verses.text: Jacob looked up—there was Esau, coming with 400 men. He arranged the children among Leah, Rachel, and the two female servants. 👀
He put the servants and their children up front, Leah and her children next, and Rachel with Joseph at the very back. 🧭
Jacob went out ahead, bowing all the way to the ground seven times as he got close to his brother. 🙇
Esau ran to him, threw his arms around him, fell on his neck, kissed him, and they both broke down weeping. 😭
Esau looked up and saw the women and children. “Who are these with you?” he asked. Jacob replied, “These are the children God graciously gave your servant.” 👨‍👩‍👧
Then the female servants came close with their children, and they bowed down. 🙇
Leah and her children also came close and bowed down. After them, Joseph and Rachel came close and bowed down. 🙇
Esau asked, “What did you mean by sending all those groups I met?” Jacob said, “I hoped to find favor with you, my lord.” 💬
Esau said, “I have plenty, my brother. Keep what’s yours.” 🤝
Jacob said, “Please, accept my gift if I’ve found favor with you. Seeing your face feels like seeing God’s face, because you’ve welcomed me. 🙏
Please take the gift I brought you. God has been gracious to me, and I have plenty.” Jacob kept urging him, and Esau accepted it. 🎁
Esau said, “Let’s get moving and travel on. I’ll go ahead of you.” 🚶
Jacob said, “My lord knows the kids are still young, and the flocks and herds have nursing young too. Push them too hard for one day and the whole flock could die. 🐑
Please, my lord, go ahead of your servant. I’ll take it slow, keeping pace with the animals and kids, until I catch up with you at Seir.” 🧭
Esau said, “Then I’ll leave some of my people with you.” Jacob replied, “Why? I only want to find favor with my lord.” 🤝
So Esau set off for Seir that same day. 🧭
Jacob traveled to Succoth, built a house for himself, and made shelters for his livestock. That’s how the place got the name Succoth. 🏠
Jacob arrived safely at Shechem in Canaan, coming from Paddan Aram, and set up camp outside the city. 🏕️
He bought the plot where he’d pitched his tent from the sons of Hamor, Shechem’s father, for 100 pieces of money. 💰
There he built an altar and named it El Elohe Israel. 🙏
